assertion.objects: A continuous finite free p-adic representation T, its rational representation V, an Euler system and the cyclotomic Iwasawa modules of Sections0.1–0.7.
assertion.hypotheses: N contains p and the ramification support; N prime to Nprime; all indices m divisible by N and coprime to Nprime; the two norm relations of0.1.1 hold.
assertion.quantifiers: Every datum meeting the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: All primes p, including2; the theorem below is restricted to height-one primes not containing p.
assertion.uniformity: Exact localized module assertions, not a uniform bound in the size of an auxiliary group.
assertion.normalizations: Arithmetic Frobenius in P_l and P_l(l^-1 sigma_l^-1); unnormalized corestriction and the actual Section0.7 class.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion here uses the stronger residual hypotheses required at primes containing p.
assertion.limit_order: The cohomology and norm inverse limits are those in Sections0.1,0.4,0.5 and0.7.
assertion.statement: Use N_K=2Nd, Nprime_K=c*d_s, source parameter d=1 and the actual retained twisted classes. The same-support norm identities identify the Section0.7 class with y_(2^infinity), up to the fixed 2-power unit at every prime in question. This source definition does not itself construct those classes or prove the norm identities.

assertion.objects: The p-adic Tate representation of an elliptic curve over Q.
assertion.hypotheses: For the open SL2 image assertion the elliptic curve is non-CM.
assertion.quantifiers: Every datum meeting the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: All primes p, including2; the theorem below is restricted to height-one primes not containing p.
assertion.uniformity: Exact localized module assertions, not a uniform bound in the size of an auxiliary group.
assertion.normalizations: Condition0.6(iii) concerns roots of P_l(t), hence weight minus one for the Tate representation.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion here uses the stronger residual hypotheses required at primes containing p.
assertion.limit_order: The p-adic Tate representation; no additional limit interchange.
assertion.statement: Apply the elliptic statement to the original non-CM curve, then its quadratic twist. The character is trivial on G_(Qab), so the same open SL2 subgroup and unipotent act on V tensor chi; both real eigenspaces have rank one. Upper and lower unipotents also give absolute irreducibility on the cyclotomic subgroup.

supplier.statement: For an elliptic Tate representation conditions0.6(i),(iii) with w=-1 and(iv) hold. For a non-CM elliptic curve, the image of G_(Qab) contains an open subgroup of SL2(Zp), supplying a nonidentity unipotent with one-dimensional fixed space.
